highlights.reason_zh: Muse Spark 从托管预告变成开放权重和多种运行路径，但 816B 体量、门控与自定义许可仍显著限制采用。
highlights.reason_en: Muse Spark moves from a hosted preview to open weights and multiple runtimes, while its 816B size, gating and custom license still materially constrain adoption.

highlights.reason_zh: Timestral 用 5M–209M 开放权重降低时间序列 foundation model 的试验成本，但排行榜优势仍待独立复测。
highlights.reason_en: Timestral lowers the trial cost of time-series foundation models with 5M–209M open weights, while leaderboard advantages still need independent reproduction.

highlights.reason_zh: GitHub AI Scan 进入 GA 并明确覆盖、合并限制和 AI Credits 计费，直接改变 AppSec 试点的成本与治理判断。
highlights.reason_en: GitHub AI Scan reaches GA with explicit coverage, merge-control limits and AI Credit billing, changing AppSec trial cost and governance decisions.

highlights.reason_zh: Claude Code 2.1.300 修复恢复丢失或重复、策略卡住、worktree 与后台服务边界，直接影响长任务可靠性。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Code 2.1.300 fixes lost or duplicated recovery, policy hangs, worktree and background-service boundaries that directly affect long-task reliability.

highlights.reason_zh: Cloudflare 与 OpenAI 的网页变化信号试点可能降低 RAG 和研究型 agent 的重复抓取，但当前仍无公开 API 或下游质量结果。
highlights.reason_en: Cloudflare and OpenAI’s web-change-signal pilot could reduce repeated crawling for RAG and research agents, but still lacks a public API or downstream quality results.

coverage_zh: 34/36 个固定入口直接完成；DeepSeek 与 NVIDIA 可选入口超时后用网页补查。主动搜索覆盖模型、工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策及非英语材料；日期级时间、厂商自报结果与研究试点限制均已保留。
coverage_en: 34/36 fixed monitors completed directly; optional DeepSeek and NVIDIA timeouts were recovered through web checks. Active search covered models, tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy and non-English material, with date-only timing, vendor-reported results and research-pilot limits explicitly preserved.
